info.title: Relic API
info.description:
Relic's own API. Every method below is a REST route under `/api/v1/`; the
same method is also served over Connect and gRPC-Web at
`POST /api/relic.v1.<Service>/<Method>`, by the same handler with the same
access checks. Errors map to HTTP statuses, with a
`{"code": <number>, "message": "..."}` body. File contents are plain HTTP
under `/api/v1/files/` and `/api/v1/archive/`.

Authenticate with basic credentials (a password or an access token) or a
bearer token. The web UI's session cookie works under `/api/` only, and
writes made with it need the `X-Relic-UI` header.

The compatibility APIs that package managers and other clients use are not
described here; the documentation lists them.

## relic.v1.RepositoryService

RepositoryService manages repositories.

## relic.v1.AgentRegistryService

AgentRegistryService lists and approves the entries of the agent
 registries: MCP server definitions in mcp repositories and skill bundles
 in skills repositories. Only approved entries are served, through
 /api/mcp/{repository}/v0/servers for MCP clients.

## relic.v1.ScanService

ScanService reads what Relic Scan found, and manages the policies and
 watches that turn findings into violations.

## relic.v1.SecurityService

SecurityService manages users, groups, permissions and access tokens.

## relic.v1.ArtifactService

ArtifactService reads and manages the items in repositories. File
 contents move over plain HTTP at /api/v1/files/<repository>/<path>.

## relic.v1.AuditService

AuditService reads the audit log: changes to administration settings,
 sign-ins, tokens and blocked downloads.

## relic.v1.BuildService

BuildService reads published build information.

## relic.v1.CleanupService

CleanupService manages cleanup policies, which move old or unused items of
 local repositories to the trash.

## relic.v1.EvidenceService

EvidenceService stores signed evidence (in-toto statements in DSSE
 envelopes) about files, and the public keys evidence is verified with.

## relic.v1.HoldService

HoldService manages legal holds. A held item, with everything under it,
 cannot be deleted, moved or overwritten, and cleanup policies skip it.

## relic.v1.IdentityProviderService

IdentityProviderService manages the identity providers users sign in with
 (single sign-on through OpenID Connect or SAML).

## relic.v1.LdapService

LdapService manages the LDAP servers users sign in with, and how their
 groups become Relic groups.

## relic.v1.PackageService

PackageService reads what packages say about themselves.

## relic.v1.PolicyDecisionService

PolicyDecisionService lists the policy decisions that blocked downloads,
 builds and promotions, and previews what a policy would violate.

## relic.v1.ProjectService

ProjectService manages projects. A repository belongs to the project its
 project field names; the project's members get their role's actions on
 it: admins and developers read, deploy, annotate and delete, viewers read.
 Project admins also manage the members and the project's repositories.

## relic.v1.PromotionGateService

PromotionGateService manages the conditions a release version must meet to
 be promoted to an environment. ReleaseService.PromoteRelease refuses a
 promotion any gate of the target environment refuses, and records each
 decision as evidence on the version's manifest.

## relic.v1.QuarantineService

QuarantineService lists the files quarantined remote repositories hold, and
 releases or rejects them.

## relic.v1.ReleaseService

ReleaseService manages releases: signed, immutable sets of artifacts taken
 from queries, files, builds or other releases, and promoted through
 environments. Each method checks the caller's release permission (read,
 write, annotate, delete or promote on the release); administrators may do
 everything. The archive of a release version is imported as plain HTTP,
 POST /api/v1/releases/import, and exported with ExportRelease.

## relic.v1.ReplicationService

ReplicationService manages push replications of local repositories.

## relic.v1.SessionService

SessionService signs the web UI in and out.

## relic.v1.SigningKeyService

KeyService shows the key pairs Relic signs repository metadata with (Debian
 and Alpine indexes, Helm and release manifests). Relic creates a key pair
 the first time a repository that names it is signed.

## relic.v1.SystemService

SystemService reports on the server itself.

## relic.v1.TrashService

TrashService manages the trash can deleted items go to.

## relic.v1.WaiverService

WaiverService takes requests for ignore rules from any signed-in user;
 administrators approve them, with an expiry, or reject them.

## relic.v1.WebhookService

WebhookService subscribes URLs to Relic's events. Each event is queued for
 every enabled webhook subscribed to its type and delivered by the worker:
 a POST signed with HMAC-SHA256 when the webhook has a secret
 (X-Relic-Signature: sha256=<hex>), tried up to 8 times with backoff.

## relic.v1.WorkloadIdentityService

WorkloadIdentityService manages the token issuers CI jobs sign in with,
 without stored secrets (SessionService.ExchangeWorkloadToken).

expires.title: expires
expires.description: expires is unset for a token that never expires.

relic.v1.AccessToken.title: AccessToken
relic.v1.AccessToken.description: AccessToken is an issued token, without its secret.

relic.v1.Action.title: Action
relic.v1.Action.description: Action is what a permission grants.

publicKey.title: public_key
publicKey.description: public_key is the key in PEM.

relic.v1.AffectedFile.title: AffectedFile
relic.v1.AffectedFile.description: AffectedFile is a file a CVE affects.

maxRuns.title: max_runs
maxRuns.description: max_runs keeps at most this many runs, newest first; 0 keeps any number.

minStarted.title: min_started
minStarted.description: min_started discards runs started before it; unset keeps runs of any age.

keep.title: keep
keep.description: keep lists run numbers that are never discarded.

session.title: session
session.description: session is the ID in the URL the CLI opened.

sha256.title: sha256
sha256.description:
sha256 is the content the administrator reviewed; when set, the approval
 fails if the entry has changed since.

days.title: days
days.description: days the ignore rule lasts, 1 to 365.

relic.v1.ArchiveEntry.title: ArchiveEntry
relic.v1.ArchiveEntry.description: ArchiveEntry is a file or folder inside an archive.

actor.title: actor
actor.description: actor is the user who acted, or anonymous.

action.title: action
action.description:
action is the method or route called, or an event such as
 download.blocked.

target.title: target
target.description: target is what the action acted on: a name, or a repository and path.

client.title: client
client.description: client is the address the request came from.

detail.title: detail
detail.description: detail is the error, or why a download was blocked.

worker.title: worker
worker.description: worker is the ID of the worker that ran the last attempt.

args.title: args
args.description: args is the job's arguments, as JSON.

output.title: output
output.description:
output is what the job recorded, as JSON, such as a storage check's
 report; empty when it recorded nothing.

relic.v1.BackgroundJob.title: BackgroundJob
relic.v1.BackgroundJob.description:
BackgroundJob is one job, as the queue keeps it (finished jobs are kept
 for a day).

states.title: states
states.description: states counts the jobs by state.

relic.v1.BackgroundJobSummary.title: BackgroundJobSummary
relic.v1.BackgroundJobSummary.description: BackgroundJobSummary is one kind of background job.

relic.v1.Build.title: Build
relic.v1.Build.description: Build is a build name and its latest run.

relic.v1.BuildArtifact.title: BuildArtifact
relic.v1.BuildArtifact.description: BuildArtifact is a file a build module produced.

relic.v1.BuildDependency.title: BuildDependency
relic.v1.BuildDependency.description: BuildDependency is a package a build module used.

scopes.title: scopes
scopes.description: scopes says how a dependency was used; empty for artifacts.

project.title: project
project.description: project is the key of the build's project; empty outside projects.

relic.v1.BuildLink.title: BuildLink
relic.v1.BuildLink.description: BuildLink is a build run that produced or used an item's content.

relic.v1.BuildModule.title: BuildModule
relic.v1.BuildModule.description: BuildModule is one module of a build run.

relic.v1.BuildRun.title: BuildRun
relic.v1.BuildRun.description: BuildRun is one run of a build.

relic.v1.BuildRunField.title: BuildRunField
relic.v1.BuildRunField.description: BuildRunField is a field of a build run.

purl.title: purl
purl.description:
purl is the package URL with its version, for example
 pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.21.

repository.title: repository
repository.description:
repository is where the package would come from; empty checks the
 malicious catalog and every active watch.

risks.title: risks
risks.description:
risks are the version's operational risks (end of life, deprecated,
 unmaintained); they refuse it only through a policy.

jobId.title: job_id
jobId.description: job_id is the queued check, or the one already queued or running.

relic.v1.Checksums.title: Checksums
relic.v1.Checksums.description: Checksums are a file's digests, lower-case hex.

relic.v1.CleanupCandidate.title: CleanupCandidate
relic.v1.CleanupCandidate.description: CleanupCandidate is an item a policy selects.

pathPattern.title: path_pattern
pathPattern.description:
path_pattern is an Ant pattern; org/app/* selects the version folders of
 org/app. Empty is **.

relic.v1.CleanupPolicy.title: CleanupPolicy
relic.v1.CleanupPolicy.description:
CleanupPolicy selects the items matching path_pattern in repositories,
 created more than older_than_days ago and not downloaded for
 not_downloaded_days, except the keep_latest newest of each folder. The
 worker moves them to the trash daily when the policy is enabled.

relic.v1.ComparisonOperator.title: ComparisonOperator
relic.v1.ComparisonOperator.description:
ComparisonOperator compares a field with a value. MATCH and NOT_MATCH
 take a pattern where * matches any run of characters and ? one character.

missing.title: missing
missing.description: missing compares with a missing value (EQUAL and NOT_EQUAL only).

relic.v1.ComparisonValue.title: ComparisonValue
relic.v1.ComparisonValue.description: ComparisonValue is the value a field is compared with.

licenses.title: licenses
licenses.description:
licenses are SPDX expressions ("MIT OR Apache-2.0") or, when the
 scanner found no SPDX license, the name it found.

licenseIds.title: license_ids
licenseIds.description: license_ids are the licenses the expressions name, each once.

violations.title: violations
violations.description:
violations are the license rules of the watches covering the item's
 repository that the component violates, ignore rules applied.

relic.v1.Component.title: Component
relic.v1.Component.description: Component is a package the scanner found.

relic.v1.ComponentLocation.title: ComponentLocation
relic.v1.ComponentLocation.description: ComponentLocation is where a component was found in the scanned content.

dryRun.title: dry_run
dryRun.description: dry_run checks the copy without doing it.

envelope.title: envelope
envelope.description: envelope is the DSSE envelope as JSON, stored as it is sent.

attachments.title: attachments
attachments.description: attachments say where the statement's attachments are stored.

provider.title: provider
provider.description: provider names what produced the evidence.

expiresDays.title: expires_days
expiresDays.description:
expires_days is the token's lifetime, at most 3650; 0 never expires for an
 administrator. Other users' tokens expire within 365 days.

scope.title: scope
scope.description:
scope is the user's own rights when unset. Only administrators may ask
 for an admin scope or groups they are not in.

project.title: project
project.description:
project is a label recorded on the token: a project the caller can see.
 It does not limit what the token can do; the scope does.

expiresIn.title: expires_in
expiresIn.description: expires_in is in seconds; 0 never expires.

relic.v1.Cve.title: Cve
relic.v1.Cve.description: Cve is everything known about one CVE.

relic.v1.CveFeed.title: CveFeed
relic.v1.CveFeed.description: CveFeed says when a feed was last read.

severity.title: severity
severity.description: severity is that of the most severe finding naming the CVE.

relic.v1.CveSummary.title: CveSummary
relic.v1.CveSummary.description: CveSummary is a CVE findings name, with how much it affects.

relic.v1.Cvss.title: Cvss
relic.v1.Cvss.description: Cvss is one CVSS rating of a finding.

numbers.title: numbers
numbers.description: numbers are the runs to delete; ignored with all.

deleteArtifacts.title: delete_artifacts
deleteArtifacts.description: delete_artifacts deletes the runs' artifacts too.

lastDownloadedBy.title: last_downloaded_by
lastDownloadedBy.description: last_downloaded_by is shown to administrators only.

relic.v1.DownloadStats.title: DownloadStats
relic.v1.DownloadStats.description: DownloadStats are an item's recorded downloads.

permissions.title: permissions
permissions.description: permissions are the names of the permissions that grant it.

relic.v1.EffectiveGrant.title: EffectiveGrant
relic.v1.EffectiveGrant.description:
EffectiveGrant is what one user or group may do on an item, and through
 which permissions.

repository.title: repository
repository.description: repository and path name the subject file.

predicate.title: predicate
predicate.description: predicate is the statement's predicate as JSON.

verified.title: verified
verified.description:
verified says whether the signature verified against a trusted key and
 the subject still has the digest the statement names.

storedPath.title: stored_path
storedPath.description: stored_path is where the evidence file is kept in the repository.

relic.v1.Evidence.title: Evidence
relic.v1.Evidence.description: Evidence is one stored evidence file about a subject file.

relic.v1.EvidenceAttachment.title: EvidenceAttachment
relic.v1.EvidenceAttachment.description: EvidenceAttachment is a file an evidence statement refers to.

identity.title: identity
identity.description: identity is the workload identity's name.

token.title: token
token.description: token is the workload's OIDC token.

username.title: username
username.description: username is who the token acts as.

policy.title: policy
policy.description: policy names the policy, or quarantine.

rule.title: rule
rule.description: rule names the policy's rule, the quarantine state, or unscanned.

archive.title: archive
archive.description: archive is the stored archive; download it from /api/v1/files/.

includeUnreachable.title: include_unreachable
includeUnreachable.description:
include_unreachable also states the vulnerabilities govulncheck found no
 call path to, per scanned file.

document.title: document
document.description: document is the VEX document (JSON) in the format asked for.

skipped.title: skipped
skipped.description:
skipped counts the rules VEX cannot express: no vulnerability or no
 package, a license, watch, policy, path or build filter, or an expiry.

id.title: id
id.description: id is the scanner's ID: CVE-…, GHSA-…, ….

malicious.title: malicious
malicious.description:
malicious marks a malicious package (an OpenSSF MAL- advisory) rather
 than a vulnerability.

reachability.title: reachability
reachability.description:
reachability is "reachable" when govulncheck found a call path to the
 vulnerable code, "not_reachable" when it found none, "unknown"
 otherwise (every finding outside Go executables).

reachabilityTrace.title: reachability_trace
reachabilityTrace.description: reachability_trace names the call path of a reachable finding.

relic.v1.Finding.title: Finding
relic.v1.Finding.description: Finding is a vulnerability found in a package.

epss.title: epss
epss.description: epss is the highest exploit probability of its CVEs; unset when unknown.

kev.title: kev
kev.description: kev says whether any of its CVEs is known to be exploited.

malicious.title: malicious
malicious.description: malicious marks a malicious package rather than a vulnerability.

relic.v1.FindingOccurrence.title: FindingOccurrence
relic.v1.FindingOccurrence.description: FindingOccurrence is a finding with one file that has it.

relic.v1.Format.title: Format
relic.v1.Format.description: Format is the kind of packages a repository holds.

agent.title: agent
agent.description: agent is the CI tool that published it (name and version).

scan.title: scan
scan.description:
scan holds the status and the findings of the dependencies and of the
 artifacts' own scans.

failBuild.title: fail_build
failBuild.description: fail_build is set when a violated rule fails builds.

files.title: files
files.description:
files is the base URL of the repository's files over the Relic API
 (<files><path> downloads and uploads).

packageManager.title: package_manager
packageManager.description:
package_manager is the URL the format's client points at: the npm
 registry, Maven or Helm repository, PyPI index or Go proxy; empty for
 formats that have none.

containerRegistry.title: container_registry
containerRegistry.description:
container_registry is the image prefix for docker and OCI clients
 (<host>/<repository>); empty for other formats.

repositories.title: repositories
repositories.description: repositories counts readable repositories by class (local, remote, virtual).

builds.title: builds
builds.description: builds counts the readable builds outside projects.

scans.title: scans
scans.description:
scans counts scanned contents by status; only administrators and viewers,
 who may list every finding, get it.

findings.title: findings
findings.description:
findings counts findings by severity; only administrators and viewers get
 it.

source.title: source
source.description: source is "feed" or "import"; empty when the server holds no data.

image.title: image
image.description: image says the item is an image tag folder.

blockDownload.title: block_download
blockDownload.description: block_download is set when a violated rule blocks downloads.

canUpload.title: can_upload
canUpload.description:
can_upload says the caller may upload to some path of the repository:
 of its deploy target, for a virtual repository; never for a remote one.

canDelete.title: can_delete
canDelete.description:
can_delete says the caller may delete some path of the repository; never
 for a virtual one.

keyPair.title: key_pair
keyPair.description: key_pair names the key pair; Alpine clients name the key file after it.

note.title: note
note.description: note is plain text; the sign-in page shows it as it is.

workers.title: workers
workers.description:
workers are the processes that ran jobs lately (the last hour), with
 what they run now.

days.title: days
days.description: days is the period, today included; 0 means 30, at most 730.

revision.title: revision
revision.description: revision is the source revision the server was built from.

defaultForNewUsers.title: default_for_new_users
defaultForNewUsers.description: default_for_new_users adds users created without groups to the group.

relic.v1.Group.title: Group
relic.v1.Group.description: Group is a set of users that permissions name together.

relic.v1.GroupStrategy.title: GroupStrategy
relic.v1.GroupStrategy.description: GroupStrategy is how an LDAP server records group membership.

relic.v1.HealthCheck.title: HealthCheck
relic.v1.HealthCheck.description: HealthCheck is the result of probing one dependency.

displayName.title: display_name
displayName.description: display_name labels the provider's button on the sign-in page.

autoCreateUsers.title: auto_create_users
autoCreateUsers.description: auto_create_users creates a Relic user on a first sign-in.

usernameClaim.title: username_claim
usernameClaim.description:
username_claim is the claim or attribute holding the username:
 preferred_username, or the SAML NameID, when empty.

groupsClaim.title: groups_claim
groupsClaim.description:
groups_claim is the claim or attribute listing the user's groups; when
 set, each sign-in makes the user a member of the Relic groups it names.

callbackPath.title: callback_path
callbackPath.description:
callback_path is output only: the path on Relic the provider sends users
 back to (the OIDC redirect URI, or the SAML assertion consumer service).

relic.v1.IdentityProvider.title: IdentityProvider
relic.v1.IdentityProvider.description: IdentityProvider is an identity provider users sign in with.

packages.title: packages
packages.description:
packages are package URLs (pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.15); one without a
 version matches every version.

relic.v1.IgnoreRule.title: IgnoreRule
relic.v1.IgnoreRule.description: IgnoreRule ignores violations matching every non-empty filter.

number.title: number
number.description: number is empty for every run.

relic.v1.IgnoredBuild.title: IgnoredBuild
relic.v1.IgnoredBuild.description: IgnoredBuild names a build, and optionally one run of it.

relic.v1.ImageLayer.title: ImageLayer
relic.v1.ImageLayer.description: ImageLayer is one layer and the build step that made it.

relic.v1.ImagePlatform.title: ImagePlatform
relic.v1.ImagePlatform.description: ImagePlatform is one platform of a multi-platform image.

document.title: document
document.description: document is an OpenVEX or CycloneDX document (JSON).

skipped.title: skipped
skipped.description:
skipped counts the statements left out: other statuses, and those
 naming no package URL.

path.title: path
path.description: path is relative to the repository root; "" is the root.

vulnerabilities.title: vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities.description:
vulnerabilities counts findings by severity (in ListChildren and
 SearchItems; for an image folder, its manifest's).

relic.v1.Item.title: Item
relic.v1.Item.description: Item is a file or folder in a repository.

relic.v1.ItemBuildComparison.title: ItemBuildComparison
relic.v1.ItemBuildComparison.description:
ItemBuildComparison matches items related to a build run whose field
 satisfies the comparison. Build comparisons of one relation in the same
 "all" group constrain the same run.

relic.v1.ItemBuildRelation.title: ItemBuildRelation
relic.v1.ItemBuildRelation.description:
ItemBuildRelation is how an item relates to a build run: an artifact the
 run produced or a dependency it used, matched by SHA-1.

relic.v1.ItemCriteria.title: ItemCriteria
relic.v1.ItemCriteria.description: ItemCriteria are the children of a group.

all.title: all
all.description: all matches when every child matches.

any.title: any
any.description: any matches when some child matches.

sameProperty.title: same_property
sameProperty.description:
same_property matches when one property satisfies every child at once;
 its children are property comparisons.

relic.v1.ItemCriterion.title: ItemCriterion
relic.v1.ItemCriterion.description: ItemCriterion is a group of criteria or one comparison.

relic.v1.ItemField.title: ItemField
relic.v1.ItemField.description: ItemField is a field of an item.

relic.v1.ItemFieldComparison.title: ItemFieldComparison
relic.v1.ItemFieldComparison.description: ItemFieldComparison compares one of the item's fields.

relic.v1.ItemPropertyComparison.title: ItemPropertyComparison
relic.v1.ItemPropertyComparison.description:
ItemPropertyComparison compares the item's properties. With compare_key
 it compares property keys; otherwise the value of the property named key
 (any property when key is empty). The negative operators match items that
 have no such property.

criteria.title: criteria
criteria.description: criteria selects items; unset matches every item.

relic.v1.ItemQuery.title: ItemQuery
relic.v1.ItemQuery.description:
ItemQuery selects items (files and folders) by their fields, their
 properties and the builds that produced or used them.

counts.title: counts
counts.description:
counts counts the findings by severity: critical, high, medium, low,
 unknown.

source.title: source
source.description: source names the file scanned for a folder (an image's manifest.json).

issues.title: issues
issues.description:
issues are what the analyzers found: secrets, misconfigurations,
 licenses in files, and code that loading a model would run.

risks.title: risks
risks.description: risks are the components' operational risks.

relic.v1.ItemScan.title: ItemScan
relic.v1.ItemScan.description: ItemScan is a file's scan state and findings.

updated.title: updated
updated.description: updated is when a producer last reported on the queue.

relic.v1.JobQueue.title: JobQueue
relic.v1.JobQueue.description: JobQueue is a named queue: its producers report in regularly.

id.title: id
id.description: id is the queue client's ID (host name and start time).

lastActive.title: last_active
lastActive.description: last_active is when it last started a job.

leader.title: leader
leader.description: leader runs the periodic jobs and the queue's maintenance.

relic.v1.JobWorker.title: JobWorker
relic.v1.JobWorker.description:
JobWorker is a process working the job queue: a Relic server or worker
 replica, known by the jobs it takes.

relic.v1.KeyPair.title: KeyPair
relic.v1.KeyPair.description: KeyPair is a signing key pair, without its private key.

ldapServer.title: ldap_server
ldapServer.description: ldap_server is the name of the LdapServer it reads.

relic.v1.LdapGroupMapping.title: LdapGroupMapping
relic.v1.LdapGroupMapping.description: LdapGroupMapping reads an LDAP server's groups into Relic groups.

url.title: url
url.description: url is ldap://host[:port]/<base DN> or ldaps://….

hasManagerPassword.title: has_manager_password
hasManagerPassword.description: has_manager_password says whether a manager password is stored.

relic.v1.LdapServer.title: LdapServer
relic.v1.LdapServer.description: LdapServer is an LDAP server users sign in with.

relic.v1.LdapUserSearch.title: LdapUserSearch
relic.v1.LdapUserSearch.description: LdapUserSearch is how users are found when no user DN pattern is set.

license.title: license
license.description: license is the expression evaluated, empty for a component without one.

relic.v1.LicenseViolation.title: LicenseViolation
relic.v1.LicenseViolation.description: LicenseViolation is a license rule a component violates.

kind.title: kind
kind.description: kind is zip, tar or tar.gz.

truncated.title: truncated
truncated.description: truncated says there were more entries than listed.

action.title: action
action.description: action and target select events whose action or target contains them.

pageSize.title: page_size
pageSize.description: page_size is at most 1000; 100 when unset.

total.title: total
total.description: total is the number of events the filters select.

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
kind and state (available, running, retryable, discarded, completed,
 cancelled, scheduled, pending) narrow the list when set.

limit.title: limit
limit.description: limit caps the list; 0 means 50, at most 500.

project.title: project
project.description: project is the project key; empty for builds outside projects.

severity.title: severity
severity.description: severity is exact; unspecified for all.

sort.title: sort
sort.description: sort: epss (default), cvss, published, affected or id.

severity.title: severity
severity.description: severity is exact; unspecified for all.

repository.title: repository
repository.description: repository limits the findings to content in one repository.

purlType.title: purl_type
purlType.description: purl_type is the package URL type (npm, maven, pypi, golang, deb, …).

fixableOnly.title: fixable_only
fixableOnly.description: fixable_only keeps findings with a fixed version.

kevOnly.title: kev_only
kevOnly.description: kev_only keeps findings whose CVEs are known to be exploited (CISA KEV).

kind.title: kind
kind.description: kind is "end_of_life", "deprecated" or "unmaintained"; empty for all.

query.title: query
query.description: query matches package and product names.

repository.title: repository
repository.description: repository limits the risks to content in one repository.

kind.title: kind
kind.description: kind filters by kind; unspecified lists every kind.

project.title: project
project.description:
project limits the list to one project's releases ("" for releases
 outside projects); unset lists every project's.

class.title: class
class.description: class and format filter the list when set.

username.title: username
username.description:
username limits an administrator's or a viewer's list to one user; others
 always see their own tokens.

pageSize.title: page_size
pageSize.description: page_size is at most 200; 50 when unset.

query.title: query
query.description:

tags.name: RepositoryService
tags.description: RepositoryService manages repositories.

tags.name: AgentRegistryService
tags.description:
AgentRegistryService lists and approves the entries of the agent
 registries: MCP server definitions in mcp repositories and skill bundles
 in skills repositories. Only approved entries are served, through
 /api/mcp/{repository}/v0/servers for MCP clients.

tags.name: ScanService
tags.description:
ScanService reads what Relic Scan found, and manages the policies and
 watches that turn findings into violations.

tags.name: SecurityService
tags.description: SecurityService manages users, groups, permissions and access tokens.

tags.name: ArtifactService
tags.description:
ArtifactService reads and manages the items in repositories. File
 contents move over plain HTTP at /api/v1/files/<repository>/<path>.

tags.name: AuditService
tags.description:
AuditService reads the audit log: changes to administration settings,
 sign-ins, tokens and blocked downloads.

tags.name: BuildService
tags.description: BuildService reads published build information.

tags.name: CleanupService
tags.description:
CleanupService manages cleanup policies, which move old or unused items of
 local repositories to the trash.

tags.name: EvidenceService
tags.description:
EvidenceService stores signed evidence (in-toto statements in DSSE
 envelopes) about files, and the public keys evidence is verified with.

tags.name: HoldService
tags.description:
HoldService manages legal holds. A held item, with everything under it,
 cannot be deleted, moved or overwritten, and cleanup policies skip it.

tags.name: IdentityProviderService
tags.description:
IdentityProviderService manages the identity providers users sign in with
 (single sign-on through OpenID Connect or SAML).

tags.name: LdapService
tags.description:
LdapService manages the LDAP servers users sign in with, and how their
 groups become Relic groups.

tags.name: PackageService
tags.description: PackageService reads what packages say about themselves.

tags.name: PolicyDecisionService
tags.description:
PolicyDecisionService lists the policy decisions that blocked downloads,
 builds and promotions, and previews what a policy would violate.

tags.name: ProjectService
tags.description:
ProjectService manages projects. A repository belongs to the project its
 project field names; the project's members get their role's actions on
 it: admins and developers read, deploy, annotate and delete, viewers read.
 Project admins also manage the members and the project's repositories.

tags.name: PromotionGateService
tags.description:
PromotionGateService manages the conditions a release version must meet to
 be promoted to an environment. ReleaseService.PromoteRelease refuses a
 promotion any gate of the target environment refuses, and records each
 decision as evidence on the version's manifest.

tags.name: QuarantineService
tags.description:
QuarantineService lists the files quarantined remote repositories hold, and
 releases or rejects them.

tags.name: ReleaseService
tags.description:
ReleaseService manages releases: signed, immutable sets of artifacts taken
 from queries, files, builds or other releases, and promoted through
 environments. Each method checks the caller's release permission (read,
 write, annotate, delete or promote on the release); administrators may do
 everything. The archive of a release version is imported as plain HTTP,
 POST /api/v1/releases/import, and exported with ExportRelease.

tags.name: ReplicationService
tags.description: ReplicationService manages push replications of local repositories.

tags.name: SessionService
tags.description: SessionService signs the web UI in and out.

tags.name: SigningKeyService
tags.description:
KeyService shows the key pairs Relic signs repository metadata with (Debian
 and Alpine indexes, Helm and release manifests). Relic creates a key pair
 the first time a repository that names it is signed.

tags.name: SystemService
tags.description: SystemService reports on the server itself.

tags.name: TrashService
tags.description: TrashService manages the trash can deleted items go to.

tags.name: WaiverService
tags.description:
WaiverService takes requests for ignore rules from any signed-in user;
 administrators approve them, with an expiry, or reject them.

tags.name: WebhookService
tags.description:
WebhookService subscribes URLs to Relic's events. Each event is queued for
 every enabled webhook subscribed to its type and delivered by the worker:
 a POST signed with HMAC-SHA256 when the webhook has a secret
 (X-Relic-Signature: sha256=<hex>), tried up to 8 times with backoff.

tags.name: WorkloadIdentityService
tags.description:
WorkloadIdentityService manages the token issuers CI jobs sign in with,
 without stored secrets (SessionService.ExchangeWorkloadToken).
